message:
Now let me build the fuzzer with ASAN and link it with libbpf.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -o /tmp/bpf-fuzzer bpf-object-fuzzer.c libbpf/src/libbpf.a -lelf -lz 2>&1 | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
